scope: test-only deterministic lifecycle fault qualification; no HR-2, HR-3, HR-4 science operator, grid, domain, precision, hydro step, deposition, or thermalization change

authoritative_states.CURRENT: A current/screen_*.npz artifact is authoritative only when its record is present in streaming_manifest.json and its file hash, canonical field hashes, identity, and current_generation provenance validate.
authoritative_states.POST: A post/screen_*.npz artifact is authoritative only after its fully fsynced atomic rename and the matching manifest record stores its file/field hashes with state POST_COMMITTED or a later permitted state.
authoritative_states.NEXT: A next/screen_*.npz artifact is authoritative only after its fully fsynced atomic rename, validation read, and the matching manifest record stores its file/field hashes with state NEXT_COMMITTED or BARRIER_VALIDATED.
authoritative_states.BARRIER: The manifest barrier is authoritative only with status PASS after every expected record has one validated POST and NEXT, no unresolved queue, no staged temporary artifact, and no duplicate NEXT identity.
authoritative_states.PROMOTION: NEXT owns the next CURRENT generation only when authoritative_generation.json validates against a PASS barrier and exactly matches the manifest promotion record. A restart must complete a previously persisted pointer-to-manifest transaction without creating another pointer transition.

non_authoritative_states: *.tmp created by atomic JSON or NPZ staging
a temporary file that has not been atomically renamed and referenced by the manifest
a manifest transaction that lacks its required artifact or promotion pointer
replay_safe_stages: F01: recompute optical/POST for a record without an authoritative POST
F02: retain the authoritative POST and reconstruct its hydro queue entry
F03: recompute hydro for a claimed record without an authoritative NEXT
F04: discard only a staged temporary NEXT artifact and recompute hydro
F05: rebuild/validate the barrier from committed NEXT records
F06: complete the one pending promotion after a persisted PASS barrier
F07: discard only the expected unreferenced renamed NEXT and recompute hydro
F08: complete a persisted promotion pointer transaction without replacing the pointer
F09: discard only the expected unreferenced renamed POST and recompute optical/POST
exactly_once_transitions: POST artifact atomic commit plus manifest reference
NEXT artifact atomic commit plus manifest reference
NEXT-to-CURRENT promotion pointer plus manifest promotion record
forbidden_recovery_behaviors: Treat a temporary, orphaned, partial, or hash-invalid artifact as authoritative
Write a second authoritative POST or NEXT for the same screen identity
Overwrite a valid authoritative artifact during recovery
Depend on a prior process RAM queue
Manually edit scientific state files to complete recovery
Weaken exact/hash comparison to a tolerance comparison

fault_ids.injection_boundary: after authoritative deposition finalization and before POST temporary write
fault_ids.recovery: rerun optical deterministically for the missing POST and continue hydro
fault_ids.comparison: POST, NEXT, final optical, deposition ledger, normalized manifest, ownership, barrier, and promotion exactly equal to clean reference

fault_ids.injection_boundary: after POST artifact and manifest commit, before enqueue/hydro claim
fault_ids.expected_authoritative_state: CURRENT and one POST; NEXT absent
fault_ids.recovery: validate and retain POST, reconstruct queue, then run hydro
fault_ids.comparison: NEXT and all clean-reference exact comparisons

fault_ids.injection_boundary: after durable HYDRO_RUNNING claim and before frozen single-screen solver result commit
fault_ids.recovery: requeue from validated POST and recompute only missing NEXT work
fault_ids.comparison: NEXT and all clean-reference exact comparisons

fault_ids.injection_boundary: after temporary NEXT is fsynced and before atomic rename
fault_ids.expected_authoritative_state: CURRENT and POST; NEXT absent; one matching staged NEXT temporary file may remain
fault_ids.recovery: formal reconstruction discards only the staged temporary artifact, requeues validated POST, and creates one authoritative NEXT
fault_ids.comparison: NEXT and all clean-reference exact comparisons

fault_ids.injection_boundary: after NEXT artifact and manifest commit, before barrier validation
fault_ids.expected_authoritative_state: CURRENT, POST, and NEXT; barrier absent or non-PASS; promotion absent
fault_ids.recovery: retain NEXT, rerun full barrier validation, then promote only after PASS
fault_ids.comparison: ownership, barrier, promotion, and all clean-reference exact comparisons

fault_ids.injection_boundary: after durable PASS barrier and before the promotion pointer transaction
fault_ids.expected_authoritative_state: CURRENT, POST, NEXT, and PASS barrier; promotion absent
fault_ids.recovery: reuse the PASS barrier and execute one promotion transaction
fault_ids.comparison: CURRENT ownership, promotion generation, and all clean-reference exact comparisons

fault_ids.injection_boundary: after durable NEXT atomic rename and before its manifest reference
fault_ids.expected_authoritative_state: CURRENT and POST; NEXT manifest reference absent; one unreferenced final NEXT file may remain
fault_ids.recovery: formal reconstruction discards only the expected orphan NEXT for a HYDRO_RUNNING record, then recomputes and commits one NEXT
fault_ids.comparison: NEXT and all clean-reference exact comparisons

fault_ids.injection_boundary: after durable authoritative_generation.json replacement and before manifest promotion save
fault_ids.expected_authoritative_state: valid NEXT pointer and PASS barrier; manifest promotion absent
fault_ids.recovery: reuse the persisted pointer verbatim and finish its manifest transaction without writing another promotion pointer
fault_ids.comparison: CURRENT ownership, promotion generation, and pointer bytes remain exact

fault_ids.injection_boundary: after durable POST atomic rename and before its manifest reference
fault_ids.expected_authoritative_state: CURRENT only; POST manifest reference absent; one unreferenced final POST file may remain
fault_ids.recovery: formal reconstruction discards only the expected orphan POST for a DEPOSITION_FINALIZED record, then recomputes and commits one POST
fault_ids.comparison: POST, NEXT, and all clean-reference exact comparisons

pass_condition: Every injected run exits at its declared deterministic boundary with only the declared authoritative state; every recovery completes through the normal reconstruction entry; all required scientific, ownership, barrier, promotion, and normalized-manifest comparisons are exact PASS.
hard_fail_condition: Any scientific array mismatch, duplicate authoritative commit, temp-as-authoritative recovery, premature or duplicate promotion, mixed generation ownership, lost screen, silent recovery, or fault-off regression.
